oneOf.description: Passes a result whose outcome is in `expect`.
Runs `run` in a scratch checkout of the result's commit.
Passes when every ask shows each part `expect` names.
Asks `model` to grade the change, once its calibration agrees with a person's labels.
The run's result: its outcome, summary, evidence and the other fields.
The result's commit, against the commit the task started from.

description:
`scorers/<name>.toml` or `.yaml`: a question that grades one finished run with `pass` or
`fail`. The file name is the scorer's name.

agreement.description:
For `judge`, the least share of labeled cases it must get right before its verdict counts;
0.8 when unset.

description.description: What the scorer checks, in one line.

evaluation.description: For `judge`, the file beside the scorer that holds its labeled cases, named `*.eval.toml`.

expect.description:
For `outcome`, the outcomes that pass. For `ask-shape`, what every ask must show: `short`,
`whatWaits` and `nextAction`.

model.description: For `judge`, the model that grades, such as `opus`.

prompt.description: For `judge`, the file beside the scorer that holds the judge's whole prompt.

run.description:
For `command`, an executable in the factory folder: exit 0 passes, 1 fails, any other
ending is an error.

timeout.description: For `command`, how long it may run before Priory kills it; 20 minutes when unset.

title: scorer
